stories.headline: Ukraine claims drone strikes on Russian ships
stories.summary: Kyiv confirms strikes in the Gulf of Finland and off Libya; Moscow calls them "terrorism".

stories.headline: COP31 collapses with no deal
stories.summary: Talks in Antalya end without a deal as oil and gas producers block a fossil-fuel phase-out.

stories.headline: CIA and spy chief's office hacked
stories.summary: CNN reports classified systems hit at the CIA and the Director of National Intelligence.

stories.headline: Huawei guilty of stealing trade secrets
stories.summary: A US jury convicts the telecom giant on 10 of 12 counts after a three-month trial.

stories.headline: WHO pulls Ebola staff out of Congo
stories.summary: Staff fled an Ituri hospital after three days sheltering; 5,775 dead of 11,762 cases.

stories.headline: Houthis hit Riyadh's tallest tower
stories.summary: Eleven wounded in Riyadh as Houthi forces push to within 60 km of Aden.
